change: Assigned Skagerrak and Kattegat as external-transfer regions using ICES Area 27.3.a
rationale: Alignment with established ICES Area definitions to ensure reproducible marine boundaries and separation of distinct hydrographic regimes. Approved in plan.

change: Adopted ICES Ecoregion Greater North Sea for domain
rationale: Provides authoritative scientifically reviewed boundaries resolving the 10E conflict
Redundant as ICES Ecoregions inherently provide reviewed marine boundaries. Approved in plan.

change: Implemented 5500m coastal buffer and centroid tie-break
rationale: Ensures robust inclusion of slightly coastal/onshore points and handles overlapping boundaries

change: Added collision_index to record IDs and utc_timestamp to sample IDs
rationale: Disambiguate identical records and prevent daily sample collisions. Approved in plan.
